# Continuation4 lifecycle evaluator preparation

Offline source preparation for `M78-CONT4-LIFECYCLE-REVIEW-PREP-01`. The evaluator uses the unchanged core hash-chain parser and `cleanM78ContinuationJournal`, requires an independently accepted continuation4 baseline result and its exact byte prefix, then supports two honest verdicts: exercise-only before restart, or full lifecycle after an actual pinned restart attestation and zero-write revisit.

Exercise admission requires exactly37 distinct intent/outcome/verified operations, all status201, the unchanged first operation, no repeated initial inventory save, decoded current history, two inventory versions, one process version, five reports and exact company total126850.17632025. Full admission additionally validates restart chronology/identity with the original restart validator and exact retained-state revisit. Continuous diagnostics must contain baseline/exercise or baseline/exercise/revisit in order, reset ordinals per phase, remain healthy/unpaused, record0/37/0 application POSTs, pair every request and preserve `keepalive:false`/zero retries.

Synthetic tests cover exercise-only and full diagnostic chains plus rehashed mutations for pooling, retry, ordinal, outcome, phase-count and error failures. Full actual journal decoding remains intentionally dependent on later closed hosted bytes; no positive hosted evidence is fabricated. No network, authentication, database, credentials, Git or existing evaluator files were used or changed. Independent QA is required.
